title: How do many agents write to the board without clobbering each other?
context: Orchestrators, workers and you will all post to the board at once: decisions, requirements, memos, thread messages. Crux today has one writer at a time and regenerates pages from JSON records.

options.name: Any agent edits any entry
options.summary: Agents read, change and save entries directly; last save wins.

cons: Lost updates when two agents save together
No record of who changed what

options.name: Orchestrator curates
options.summary: Only the current orchestrator writes board entries; workers and you post into threads and it turns them into entries.

cons: Your own picks wait for the orchestrator

options.name: Append-only event log
options.summary: Every action (a message, a pick, a new requirement) is appended as an event; entries and the index are rebuilt from the log, as Crux pages are rebuilt from JSON today.
options.sketch: <svg viewBox='0 0 320 180'><rect x='10' y='20' width='80' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='50' y='44' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Agents</text><rect x='10' y='120' width='80' height='40' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='50' y='144' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>You</text><line x1='90' y1='40' x2='128' y2='78' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='128,78 121.4,75.7 125.7,71.4' fill='currentColor'/><line x1='90' y1='140' x2='128' y2='102' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='128,102 125.7,108.6 121.4,104.3' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='130' y='65' width='80' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--accent)' fill-opacity='0.85' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='170' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Event log</text><line x1='210' y1='90' x2='238' y2='90' stroke='currentColor'/><polygon points='238,90 231.7,93.0 231.7,87.0' fill='currentColor'/><rect x='240' y='65' width='70' height='50' rx='6' fill='var(--muted)' fill-opacity='0.35' stroke='currentColor'/><text x='275' y='94' font-size='12' text-anchor='middle' fill='currentColor'>Board</text></svg>
pros: No lost updates: appends never collide
Full history of who did what, for free
Messages and memory share one log
cons: A rebuild step between log and board
Needs care to keep rebuilds fast as the log grows

recommendation: An append-only log makes concurrent writers safe and gives the conversation and the memory one source; it is the same records-in, pages-out pattern Crux already uses.

settles.value: append-only event log; entries and index rebuilt from it
